messages:
Mira: Nightly eval spike — our tool-runner JSON parser failed on 51/200 runs for the q5_onboard candidate. Model is producing JS-style objects in function args (trailing commas + // comments). Failing schema check and aborting the call.

nightly-bot: nightly-eval: model=q5_onboard, run=2026-03-19T07:12Z, failures=51, tests=200, error=fnargs_parse_error

Devon: Can you paste a raw example of the payload the model emitted? need to see exact form.

Mira: Pasted one below (copied straight from eval logs):
```
{"action": "rank_items", "args": { // user-provided ranking
  "items": ["a", "b", "c",], // trailing comma
  "weights": [0.2, 0.5, 0.3], // fine
},}
```
This is what breaks our strict JSON decoder in the tool runner. Parser error: Unexpected token '/' at position 34.

Sam: Ugh. That's JS-style JSON (comments + trailing commas). Not typical model behaviour for us. Did prompt include JS examples? Could be from the prompt template.

Anya: I checked the promptset used in this nightly suite — we included a few human-crafted examples showing object literals with inline comments for readability (we thought they'd be ignored). Looks like the model mirrored the style. snippet from prompt: 
```
// rank items by preference
const request = { items: ["x","y"], /* weights optional */ }
```
That probably nudged it.

Devon: Two vectors: 1) quick fix in runner to attempt small-normalization (strip // comments and trailing commas) as a preprocessing step, but log and count normalizations; 2) long-term: update prompt templates to remove JS-style samples. Thoughts?

Sam: I can open a small PR for a safe normalizer using a json5-lite strip (no eval). We must be explicit: only run normalizer if strict JSON parse fails, and then emit a metric so we don't silently accept broken schema.

Mira: Agreed. Important: do not let normalizer mask other schema issues (like stringified arrays or blob fields). Add a warning with the exact pre/post strings in the logs.

Anya: Also confirm baseline models (non-quant q4 baseline) didn't produce this pattern. I ran a quick diff: baseline had 3/200 instances with stray trailing commas (probabilistic), q5_onboard had 51 and often with comments. So model change + prompt examples likely amplified it.

Devon: Action items: Sam -> PR for normalization + metric (MR #?), Anya -> scrub examples from promptset and push updated prompts to nightly harness, Mira -> add a short note to the eval failure triage doc and flag the model onboarding issue.

Sam: I'll target a tiny pipeline change: try strict JSON parse first; on failure, run normalizer that: remove //... and /*...*/ blocks, drop trailing commas in objects/arrays, then re-parse. If re-parse works, tag event with tag=normalized_jsstyle and include original/raw in debug blob.

Mira: Sounds good. Please also add a rate-limit on normalization logging since this'll be noisy if model keeps emitting. 1 per test-case should be fine.

Devon: Also let's not auto-fallback to a different model variant; keep failure visible so we don't mask regressions that are semantic rather than syntactic.

Anya: Will push prompt edits now. Ping when PR is up so CI can run against the nightly suite. :thumbsup:

Mira: Thanks all — tagging the onboarding ticket: ONB-342. I'll update triage once PR and prompts are in.

Sam: PR opened -> MR 4821, small python util + tests. Will link CI when green.

nightly-bot: update: re-run scheduled in 2h after PR merge and prompt scrub.

Mira: Closing loop here for now. If anyone sees other odd JS-literal artifacts (e.g., trailing semicolons inside JSON strings, template literals), drop them in this thread.
